brief: Fix items 1-4: deploy final build, warm-up survives past idle window, ADR-062 tier 3 (TURN) for UDP-blocked viewers, encoder congestion-controls the viewer link. Tests for each. Release branch only.

goals.title: warmup
goals.objective: Warm capture helps a panel opened long after boot (fix rebuild-on-attach), with tests
goals.evidence: adapt_reset added contract-first (asyncapi+zod regenerated); encoder handles it without runCaptureAndOffer (guard test); CaptureSession.ResetAdaptation; handover switched from Recapture; gateway handover test + captureext tests pass; ext 1.0.14 pinned

goals.title: congestion
goals.objective: Encoder bitrate driven by viewer RTCP, not the loopback hop, with tests
goals.evidence: RTCP ReceiverReport now read in drainViewerRTCP; AIMD policy in bitrate.go (pure, 8 tests incl floor/ceiling/hysteresis/throttle); set_bitrate contract action + max_bitrate field regenerated; encoder clamps and is guarded; webrtc+captureext suites pass; ADR-062 Finding 2 marked RESOLVED

goals.title: turn
goals.objective: ADR-062 tier 3 embedded TURN with scoped permissions + short-lived creds, ICE servers on the wire, with tests
goals.evidence: TURN server implemented with scoped permission handler (test proves loopback/metadata/private/internet refused), short-lived per-viewer TURN-REST creds, own configured port; ice_servers added to BrowserWebRTCStateFrame contract-first and delivered on the availability frame; SPA adopts them via setICEServers with STUN kept; 5 Go tests + 3 vitest tests pass; ADR-062 tier 3 marked IMPLEMENTED with the Fly TCP caveat

goals.title: deploy
goals.objective: Deploy final build and validate hosted end to end
goals.evidence: Deployed 6368ef49 + TURN declared on swimlane. Verified on the box: warm-up started, UDP 50000 and 50002 both bound on fly-global-services, ice_servers delivered to a real Chrome with per-viewer TURN-REST credential (expiry in username). Hosted e2e: first frame 7.0s, 15fps, scroll 349/326ms, zero console errors.

goals.title: verify
goals.objective: CI green on release/v0.1.1 with everything landed
